name: history-bound-commit-tree
goal: Keep per-tree reads within the shared immutable blob cache bound during history reconstruction.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The per-tree cache retains every resolved blob even when the shared cache refuses blobs larger than its 64 MiB limit; the guarded history probe exceeded 5 GiB after 18 revisions.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing read/populated method case checks reuse across trees but never checks oversized blobs or eviction; extend that same case using real Git reads.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red 5923c59fe36f at 752276fac4 proves oversized blob text is retained by the per-tree cache.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit e9ca66832d removes completed requests from the per-tree map while retaining bounded shared caching.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Green 41250f40a07d passes the unchanged read case in the same environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
